title: TDD: Demonstrate Ralph skill is installable
description: Write a TDD test that demonstrates Ralph as a skill is installable. The test should verify that Ralph skill files can be copied to a target project and are usable. Follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR methodology. Test should initially fail (RED) for missing functionality, then we implement the skill installation mechanism, then test passes (GREEN).
close_reason: TDD tests created and passing. Tests verify Ralph skill installation and basic invocation setup.

title: TDD: Demonstrate installed Ralph skills support basic invocation of the Ralph loop
description: Write a TDD test that demonstrates installed Ralph skills support basic invocation of the Ralph loop. The test should verify that after installing Ralph skill, a basic invocation (e.g., running ralph.sh with minimal PRD) works correctly. Follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR methodology. Test should initially fail (RED) for missing functionality, then we implement the skill invocation mechanism, then test passes (GREEN).
close_reason: TDD tests created and passing. Tests verify Ralph skill installation and basic invocation setup.
